summary: Outcast is a Burleigh Heads (Gold Coast) online womenswear brand with offices in the Gold Coast and Los Angeles. Leilani Van Dohren became Finance Manager in March 2026 in a newly created role reporting to the CFO, and has been hiring a Financial Accountant whose duties include reconciling e-commerce platforms and payment gateways; the role was still being advertised in November 2026.
